fixtures.name: The bridge incident · Text FX
fixtures.input:
"Already froze the branch before I sent the ping, sweetheart, your live push isn't going anywhere."

"[[ve:rage]]You did what? Kitty, if you sandboxed a mid-compile thread, you just buried the third fault under forty layers of garbage logs![[/ve:rage]]"

All three monitors flashed stark white, dumped a rolling wall of [[vt:neon]]FAILED ROLLBACK[[/vt]] lines, and triggered a sharp containment chime from the ceiling vent. His right-eye interface threw [[ve:haze]]a violent smear of ghosted hexadecimal[[/ve:haze]] across the dark lens of his brow.

"[[ve:whisper]]Session is over, Gabrielle.[[/ve:whisper]]" Zephyr said. Watching the flushed scorch stripe above his brow, [[ve:fear]]Zephyr felt a cold, steady tightness settle behind his ribs[[/ve:fear]].

"You had forty hours without anyone hovering. [[ve:crossed]]You lost an eyebrow and blew a live conduit.[[/ve:crossed]]"

[[ve:memory]]The heavy bulkhead groaned shut behind them, shearing the roar of the cooling fans down to a distant vibration beneath the deck plates.[[/ve:memory]]

Ten feet ahead, the lift doors chimed without being called, slid halfway apart with a grinding shudder, and jammed hard against a glitching proximity sensor. [[ve:chaos]]The overhead strips snapped violently into stark emergency crimson.[[/ve:chaos]]

"Looks like Kitty's sandbox is leaking, big guy. Still want to lock me in a dark room while the hallway eats itself?"

fixtures.scriptName: 📝 [FOOTNOTES] Wrapped term · clickable phrase · native popover
fixtures.input:
Gabrielle snapped the [[term#fn-0-1: manual bridge override | A hardware toggle connected directly to the local control bridge]], and the conduit threw a shower of white sparks across his boots.

His right optic flooded with [[note#fn-0-2: ghosted hexadecimal | The current clamp temporarily corrupted the visual overlay]]. Zephyr caught the [[lore#fn-0-3: magnetic security keycard | A badge granting access to facility routing and residential locks]] before Gabrielle could reach the rack.

Kitty watched the monitor flash crimson. [[aside#fn-0-4: This is fine | The rollback is currently rewriting the corridor lighting schedule]].
